newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 29.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - The labour insurance law will apply to the banking industry starting January 1997.
Taiwan does not rule out possibilty that President Lee Teng-hui may meet western leaders if he attends an international conference in Panama next year.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - The labour insurance law will apply to the banking industry in January 1997.
The economy shows a "green light" condition in September, indicating a recovery.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - The labour insurance law will apply to the banking industry in 1997.
The U.S. dollar surges overseas on buying spree.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - The labour insurance law is expected to apply to the banking industry before December 6.
A parliamentary committee approves draft on the futures law.
